summary: Waterdrop Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes net operating revenue of RMB1,242.2 million (US$180.1 million), a 64.8% year-over-year increase; insurance-related income of RMB1,145.8 million (US$166.1 million), up 74.1%; and operating profit of RMB80.0 million (US$11.6 million), up 5.3%. The company highlighted growth in medical crowdfunding, patient enrollment via its E-Find platform, and AI deployment, along with a shareholder return program involving ADS repurchases of ~61.8 million ADSs for ~US$120.1 million and a cash dividend of ~US$10.8 million. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation transaction. No deal terms are provided as the filing is a periodic financial update without M&A, tender, or restructuring events.
